双体船能载好多人去海边呢！
catastrophe: A catastrophe is a very bad thing.
大灾难就是非常非常糟糕的事。
Was the big rain a catastrophe for the bugs?
那场大雨对小虫子来说是大灾难吗？
catfish: The catfish swims in the river.
鲶鱼在小河里游来游去。
Can we see a catfish at the lake?
我们能在湖边看见鲶鱼吗？
The catfish has a flat, wide head!
鲶鱼的脑袋又扁又宽呢！
cathedral: The big cathedral is very old.
Did you go into the tall cathedral?
你进去过高高的教堂吗？
Look at the colorful windows in the cathedral!
快看教堂里五彩缤纷的玻璃窗！
causeway: The bus goes over the causeway to the coast.
公交车经过长堤开往海边。
Did you walk on the long causeway?
你在那条长堤上走过吗？
What a wide causeway over the water!
cautionary: This is a cautionary story about fire.
这是一个关于用火安全的警示故事。
Why do we read cautionary stories?
我们为什么要读有警示意义的故事呢？
听听她那些劝诫的话吧！
cavalry: In the old story, the cavalry has fast horses.
在古老的故事里，骑兵队有好马。
Look at the cavalry on their horses!
快看骑在马上的骑兵队！
cavort: The goats cavort in the green field.
小山羊们在绿色的田野里撒欢。
小鹿们喜欢在哪里撒欢呀？
Look at the monkeys cavorting in the trees!
快看猴子们在树上蹦蹦跳跳呢！
cello: She plays the cello at school.
Can your brother play the cello?
I love the low song of the cello!
我喜欢大提琴低低的琴声！
cellophane: 玻璃纸是用什么做的呀？
Take the cellophane off the candy, please.
请把糖果外面的玻璃纸剥掉。
